proves.claim: On a sprint board a reject of landed work, run with verify reject --no-next, reverts the landing on main, leaves one pull-out job and one pulled event, reopens the item, and the builder's next re-offers it with the reject reason.

cli.sprint.reject-pulls-out.why: Without it a reject of landed sprint work wrote pull_out and nothing ran the job, so the rejected work stayed on main.

proves.claim: A steady reject queues no pull-out job, records no pulled event, leaves main unchanged and reopens the item, as today.

cli.sprint.steady-reject-unchanged.why: The pull-out must run only for sprint work; steady boards keep today's reject.
